comment: What /artifact-to-unity last cloned into the game, per vessel. pageSha: the commit of the studio page the clone read; decisionsThrough: the newest artifact decision (createdAt / at) already applied. The next clone starts from here.

Stoat.result: 50 mapped parameters match the artifact (studio_to_unity.py --check). Cloned the waves: the light shells in and out, the gravitational wave (lens + prisms), dieS, whSizeX. The shared log held no newer decision (only d16-d17, no settings snapshot).

Shrike.result: First clone: the whole kit (docking, Nest, Void Lance, Void Sling, Targeting Array + missiles, the thin / thick trail) ported from the page's stepPilot into ShrikeExecutor / ShrikeRules, the prefab rebuilt from BrittleStar.prefab (author_shrike_assets.py). 29 mapped parameters match (studio_to_unity.py --check); the five elemental ranges ported by hand into ShrikeConfig.asset and held by ShrikeConfigTests. The decision log was empty. 2026-10-15 later: Garrett's control/flora redesign was built in Unity directly (LT zoom, RT by mode, Mass detach-and-nest, missile-growing flora, priority lock, Void Pierce); the studio page is now BEHIND the game - see R_VesselActions/SHRIKE.md section 6. nestHealth / nestHealthMax / crystalHealth unmapped (retired in the game).

Angler.result: Eighth clone (round 7). The Sparrow's buttons: Lure (Mass) on A / Space, Dash (Time) on B / T (the keyboard's Button2 moved from R to T on bleeding-edge), squad pick on X / Q, recall on Y / F (author_angler_assets.py CONTROLS + the element map). Game-only listen fix: the picked squad shows over the Mass card, PickTarget skips prisms the creature's own diet refuses (Fauna.LeashCanEat), the latch cluster skips body prisms. 27 mapped, 0 drift. Earlier: v9 round 6, v8 round 5, v7 round 4, v6 round 3, v5, v4, v3.

Goby & Pistol.artifactVersion: private prototype https://claude.ai/artifact/6hGNJz2AKFYY5gHvYJa9Up v11 (the lab is not on the shared Vessel Studio artifact yet)
Goby & Pistol.labAhead: v14 (2026-10-21): the Pistol's marks are in the world (lit prisms and trail tiles, lit flares; PistolWarp's rings are what the clone replaces). v13 (2026-10-21): the default view is the Tangent plane (a 2.5D Pistol on a plane tangent to the Goby's path, no warp, the PrismDepthPlane depth look) with five lab-only numbers (pPlaneEase, pRollEase, pChord, pMaxLean, pDepthSpread). v12 (2026-10-18): 10 mapped numbers (pGravity, pDiveMul, pMinSpeed, pDrag, pBodyR, pViewWidth, pLaunchRange, pLaunchSpeed, tHillEvery, tHillAmp) plus the downhill lean and camera roll, the slingshot, the Settled unroll and the rigid prism blend. Clone after Garrett plays v13 (team task T-20261018-675f).
Goby & Pistol.decisionsThrough: none (the prototype's decision log is empty)
Goby & Pistol.result: 2026-10-18 (v11): the vortex ring and the flares are lit faceted volumes, in the 3D world and in the Pistol's view (nothing in the world looks flat): PistolWarp.VortexRingFacets, URP Lit materials, the view's ring on the solid pass. 2026-10-18: the Pistol's view drawn as the game draws it (PistolTrueDraw: real meshes and materials, lit, under the sky, through a perspective camera whose frustum is the parallax; the lab's side view the same). 45 mapped parameters match the artifact (studio_to_unity.py --check). 2026-10-16: gCruise is mapped to Goby.prefab DefaultThrottleScaler (160, the Goby's own cruise; author_goby_assets.py writes and checks it from the lab), the closeness speed (gCloseMax 2.4, gCloseRange 320) and the AI Goby's easing (aiMaxGap 260) are cloned as GobyMath, the launch is 1 charge / 9 s. Earlier: the lab's maths line for line (PistolRibbon, PistolBodyMath, VortexRing, PistolAI) and the Pistol's VIEW (PistolWarp, PistolWorldMesh, PistolWorld.shader), held to the page's goldens. 16 keys stay lab-only (--unmapped): the Goby's turn rates are the Squirrel prefab's own; the straight boost waits; seeding, hinge tilt, Goby AI weave, run length, swapCd.
Goby & Pistol.retired: 2026-10-22: Garrett redesigned the Goby's kit straight in Unity ("we already have the pair in the game ... go straight to unity"): the Goby darts and perches, the Pistol rides a flat plane perch to perch, builds dens, pulls mass into its plane and fires homing rings. goby.json (the lab-to-asset map) was removed with the old config's fields; the lab (goby.html) is behind the game until a lab round ports this kit. See .claude/skills/duo-vessel/references/designs/goby-and-pistol.md section 11.
